_readme: Risk-acceptance register for the CASA AL1 scan gate.
CASA expects accepted risk to be explicit and justified, not silently
suppressed. Entries here are still printed in full in the generated report
(section 4) — they are excluded from the pass/fail gate only. An assessor
reads this file directly, so every reason must stand on its own without a
Consumed by scripts/casa-report.mjs. Schema per entry:
id       (required) CodeQL rule ID, or npm package name for an advisory.
file     (optional) Restrict the acceptance to one path. Omit to accept
the rule everywhere — prefer scoping to a file.
reason   (required) Why this is not exploitable here, or why the residual
risk is accepted. 'False positive' alone is not a
reason; say what makes it one.
reviewBy (optional) ISO date for re-examination. Anything accepted
because an upstream fix is pending belongs here.
Note: advisories in the dev/build toolchain tree do not need entries. They
are already reported as INFORMATIONAL and never gated — see
